interpretation.no_input_completion: Missing causal observations leave an insufficient-input assessment and no complete23 flags. Partial known score facts are not a Ready/play-success result.
interpretation.output_negative_scope: One-bit deviation from the declared normal row only; literal consistency is not independent proof of baseball semantics.
interpretation.incomplete_branch_is_not_product_rejecti: An issue here describes the full first-matching-branch authored case, not automatically insufficient numeric flags or a public rejection. q0004/q0005 retain a known numeric projection while the first branch remains unknown.
